text: The SICAM A8000 CP‑8050 is a lean and compact RTU designed for reliable control and automation in demanding power distribution environments. With support for rack‑based I/Os, fiber‑optic interface modules, and extendable communication interfaces, the CP‑8050 adapts easily to a wide range of substation and grid automation use cases.
